panels.title: Spend caps in force

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE sl.scope_type WHEN 'organization' THEN 'Everyone (default)'
        WHEN 'user' THEN coalesce(e.email, sl.scope_id) ELSE 'Group ' || sl.scope_id END AS "who", sl.scope_type AS scope, sl.period, (sl.amount/100.0)::numeric(12,2) AS cap_usd,
        sl.updated_at AS "updated", replace(sl.created_by,'admin-key:','') AS "set by"
     FROM spend_limits sl LEFT JOIN principal_emails e ON e.principal = sl.scope_id
     ORDER BY CASE sl.scope_type WHEN 'organization' THEN 0 WHEN 'rbac_group' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, sl.period

panels.description: Org and group caps are per-person defaults, not shared pools. A per-user cap overrides them for that person (higher or lower). Each period is enforced independently.

panels.title: Spend ledger (metered usage)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(e.email, s.principal) AS "who", s.period, round((s.cents/100)::numeric,4) AS usd, s.updated_at AS "updated"
     FROM spend s LEFT JOIN principal_emails e ON e.principal = s.principal ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: Nothing metered yet. Real model calls are needed.

panels.description: The gateway's own ledger of what each principal has spent per period (list-price estimate, not billing). Empty until a real model call is metered; load-test replies are not metered.

panels.title: Cap history (each adjustment)

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
        SELECT a.at AS time, CASE coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'type' WHEN 'organization' THEN 'Everyone (default)'
        WHEN 'user' THEN coalesce(e.email, coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'user_id')
        ELSE 'Group ' || coalesce(coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'rbac_group_id','?') END || ' · ' || coalesce(coalesce(a.after, a.before)->>'period','') AS metric,
               CASE WHEN a.after IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (a.after->>'amount')::numeric/100 END AS value
        FROM admin_audit a LEFT JOIN principal_emails e ON e.principal = coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'user_id' WHERE a.action LIKE 'spend_limit.%' )
      SELECT time, metric, value FROM ev WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT now(), metric, (array_agg(value ORDER BY time DESC))[1] FROM ev GROUP BY metric
      ORDER BY time

panels.description: Each dot is one adjustment; the line holds that cap until the next change and runs to now. A drop to zero is a deleted cap.

panels.title: Requests by user

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 60))) AS time,
        if(email='','(unauthenticated)',email) AS user, count() AS requests FROM otel.v_gateway_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('$data' = 'all' OR ('$data' = 'real' AND NOT is_load_test) OR ('$data' = 'loadtest' AND is_load_test)) GROUP BY time, user ORDER BY time

panels.description: Who is calling the gateway over time.

panels.title: Budget adjustment log

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.at AS "time", a.actor AS "changed by",
        CASE a.action WHEN 'spend_limit.upsert' THEN CASE WHEN a.before IS NULL THEN 'created' WHEN (a.after->>'amount')::numeric > (a.before->>'amount')::numeric THEN 'raised' WHEN (a.after->>'amount')::numeric < (a.before->>'amount')::numeric THEN 'lowered' ELSE 'unchanged' END
          WHEN 'spend_limit.delete' THEN 'deleted' ELSE a.action END AS change,
        CASE coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'type' WHEN 'organization' THEN 'Everyone (default)'
        WHEN 'user' THEN coalesce(e.email, coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'user_id')
        ELSE 'Group ' || coalesce(coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'rbac_group_id','?') END AS "applies to", coalesce(a.after, a.before)->>'period' AS period,
        (a.before->>'amount')::numeric/100 AS "from_usd", (a.after->>'amount')::numeric/100 AS "to_usd",
        coalesce(a.reason,'') AS reason
     FROM admin_audit a LEFT JOIN principal_emails e ON e.principal = coalesce(a.after, a.before)->'scope'->>'user_id' WHERE $__timeFilter(a.at) ORDER BY a.at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Every change to a spend limit, who made it and the before/after amounts. From the gateway's admin_audit table; it cannot be edited through the API.

panels.title: Usage by user

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(email='','(unauthenticated)',email) AS "user", count() AS requests, countIf(outcome='ok') AS ok,
        countIf(outcome!='ok') AS failed, arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(m -> m != '', groupUniqArray(model)), ', ') AS models, max(ts) AS "last seen"
      FROM otel.v_gateway_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('$data' = 'all' OR ('$data' = 'real' AND NOT is_load_test) OR ('$data' = 'loadtest' AND is_load_test)) GROUP BY email ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.description: Who is using the gateway in the selected range.

panels.title: Request tracker

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.ts AS time, r.request_id AS request_id, if(r.email='','(unauthenticated)',r.email) AS user, if(r.model='','(none)',r.model) AS model,
        multiIf(r.outcome='ok','OK',r.outcome='rejected','Rejected by gateway',r.outcome='spend_cap','Spend cap','Upstream error') AS outcome, r.status AS status, r.latency_ms AS ms, u.cause AS cause
      FROM otel.v_gateway_requests r LEFT JOIN otel.v_upstream_errors u ON u.request_id = r.request_id
      WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND ('$data'='all' OR ('$data'='real' AND NOT r.is_load_test) OR ('$data'='loadtest' AND r.is_load_test))
        AND ('$request_id' = '' OR r.request_id = '$request_id') ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Newest requests with the provider's failure cause. Paste a request_id into the variable above to isolate one call.
